title: Tech News
about: The daily five-minute Tech News segment Lauren, Will, and I turned into a mix of announcements, improvised comedy, and running jokes.
description: This track remembers Tech News, the short morning segment Lauren, Will, and I hosted as the three Tech ADs. What began as a few announcements became its own daily comedy routine, with ideas often invented only moments before the theme started. One morning Will and I secretly hosted from the spotlight towers while everyone searched the stage for us, and the daily weather report became a running joke where I raced down the hall to look outside. It was only a few minutes each morning, but it became something people genuinely looked forward to.
lyrics: Verse 1
Every morning, same old stage,
Thirty minutes to start the day.
Participants gathered one by one,
Wondering what we'd have to say.
Lauren, Will, and I took our seats,
A table standing center stage.
It wasn't really just about tech,
It was comedy on a schedule each day.
Pre-Chorus
A few announcements, a little fun,
Then we'd see where the morning went.
Most of it wasn't even planned,
That was half the entertainment.
Chorus
Good morning, welcome to Tech News,
Where anything could make the news.
Schedules, stories, laughs out loud,
Starting every morning with the crowd.
Five little minutes, that's all we'd need,
To wake the room before the day.
Somehow the smallest part each morning
Became what people came to see.
Verse 2
One day right before the theme began,
Will and I had one more plan.
Lauren stayed where she'd always be,
While we climbed where no one could see.
The music played, the room filled up,
Everyone looked toward the stage.
Meanwhile from the spotlight towers
We carried on like nothing changed.
Pre-Chorus
You could almost hear the question,
"Where'd they disappear to now?"
Watching everyone keep searching
Made us laugh without a sound.
Chorus
Good morning, welcome to Tech News,
Live from somewhere with a better view.
The stage was empty, heads looked down,
While we watched from high above the crowd.
Every morning brought a brand new joke,
Never quite the same routine.
The best ideas were often born
Just moments before the theme.
Bridge
Then came the weather every day.
"How's it looking outside?" they'd say.
I'd take off running down the hall,
Race to the window, give my call.
Somehow that became the part
Everybody waited for.
A simple joke that somehow grew
Into something people looked forward to.
Final Chorus
Good morning, welcome to Tech News,
Changing just enough to make it new.
A little laughter, real updates,
Five short minutes to start each day.
Long before the work began,
Before the schedules took control,
Three Tech ADs found a way
To wake the room... and steal the show.
Outro
"Good morning everyone..."
The music starts.
The crowd gathers.
And somewhere... Tech News is about to begin.
